title: Quadratic formula
subject: Math
learningGoal: Solve any quadratic equation using the quadratic formula.
spokenLines: The quadratic formula solves any quadratic equation.
Any quadratic looks like a x squared plus b x plus c equals zero.
The formula is x equals negative b, plus or minus the square root of b squared minus four a c, all over two a.
Let's solve x squared minus five x plus six equals zero.
Here a is one, b is negative five, c is six.
Plug in: five, plus or minus root of twenty five minus twenty four, over two.
That's five plus or minus one, over two.
So x is three, or x is two.
